name: unihub-auth-bridge
description: Appwrite Function: JWT bridge between the UniHub Users/Auth project and the Storage project. Faithful Node.js port of the original Kotlin bridge (service/appwrite/auth-bridge) kept because this Appwrite Cloud project/region does not offer a Kotlin/JVM function runtime (verified live on 2026-10-15: GET /v1/functions/runtimes lists 32 runtimes, none Kotlin/Java).
